items.title: Snowy 2.0 to cost 12 times more than initial budget with further delays
items.summary: Australia's biggest renewable energy project, which has faced financial and timeline challenges since its inception, could now cost $25 billion and is expected to be delivered in late 2029.

items.title: Equal-Weight Index Defies S&P 500's 1.4% Decline
items.summary: The stock market was struggling on an index level, but under the surface things were less dire.

items.title: Procter & Gamble earnings beat as sales rise 4%, boosted by laundry and home products
items.summary: Procter & Gamble topped Wall Street's estimates for its quarterly earnings and revenue.

aus.headline: Snowy 2.0 Cost Blowout
aus.body: The big renewable energy project may now cost $25b, with completion slipping to late 2029.
aus.why: The bill is now 12 times the first budget for a key power project.

us.headline: S&P 500 Slides 1.4%
us.body: The S&P 500 fell 1.4%, but the equal-weight version of the index held up better.
us.why: Wall Street sell-offs often set the tone for the ASX open.

biz.headline: P&G Tops Profit Estimates
biz.body: Procter & Gamble beat estimates as laundry and home products lifted sales 4%.
biz.why: A read on how shoppers are spending on everyday household goods.
